summary: Baserow is a self-hosted database management tool that allows you to build relational databases and interfaces through a spreadsheet-like interface. It functions as an open-source alternative to proprietary cloud platforms like Airtable. You can organise, query, and collaborate on structured data without writing traditional database code.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you want to replace cloud-based spreadsheet databases with an on-premise solution under an MIT licence.
watchOut: You should verify its active maintenance and update cadence before relying on it for critical production workloads, as activity metrics can vary.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
